description: Estimate toll cost for a road trip from 2-10 place names: per-km tolls, vignettes, bridges and tunnels, as a EUR range with a per-country breakdown. Flags partial results when a country on the route has no data. Use it only for the toll cost between named places when no other trip details are asked; for a whole trip use plan_road_trip.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

vehicle_class.description: car; van = campervan/motorhome up to 3.5 t (default); heavy = over 3.5 t.

waypoints.description: 2-10 place names in travel order: cities or countries (a country means its capital), e.g. ["Rome", "Paris"].

name: estimate_route_tolls
title: Estimate Tolls For A Route
